items.title: Claude Certified Associate – Foundations
items.audience: Consultants, sellers and delivery leads who guide customers toward the right Claude use cases and set engagements up for success.
items.description: Validates that you can operate Claude with professional discipline, turning everyday business problems into reliable Claude workflows you can stand behind.

items.title: Claude Certified Developer – Foundations
items.audience: Engineers who build with the Claude API, Claude Code and Model Context Protocol, from first integration to production agents.
items.description: Validates that you can build production-grade applications, agents and workflows on Claude, and make the engineering decisions that keep code reliable when real users depend on it.

items.title: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
items.audience: Partners who design Claude solutions end to end: deployment platforms, agentic architectures, evaluation, cost and safety.
items.description: Validates that you can make informed decisions about tradeoffs when implementing real-world solutions with Claude, across Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, the Claude API and Model Context Protocol.

items.title: Claude Certified Architect – Professional
items.audience: Partners who design Claude solutions end to end: deployment platforms, agentic architectures, evaluation, cost and safety.
items.description: Validates that you can design, integrate and govern production-grade Claude systems end to end, and defend those design decisions to the stakeholders who fund and approve them.

items.title: GitHub Copilot
items.description: Candidates for this exam should possess expertise in using GitHub Copilot to improve software development productivity, quality, and security. This includes responsible AI use, prompt engineering, Copilot features across various plans, and privacy safeguards.

items.title: GitHub Certified: Agentic AI Developer
items.description: You should have subject matter expertise in operating, integrating, supervising, and governing AI agents inside production-grade SDLC workflows and development environments, ensuring reliability, safety, and velocity using GitHub as the system of record and control plane.

items.title: GitHub Certified: Agentic AI Business Professional (beta)
items.description: As a candidate for this certification, you are in business professional roles including, but not limited to, product manager, program manager, technical project manager, and business analyst.

items.title: Claude 101
items.description: Learn how to use Claude for everyday work tasks, understand core features, and explore resources for more advanced learning on other topics.

items.title: Claude Code 101
items.description: Learn how to use Claude Code effectively in your daily development workflow.

items.title: Claude Platform 101
items.description: This course teaches developers to build on the Claude Platform from the ground up, whether you've made a few API calls or have only used Claude through a chat window.

items.title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
items.description: Learn to work alongside Claude on your real files and projects. This hands-on course covers the Cowork task loop, plugins and skills, file and research workflows, and how to steer multi-step work responsibly — so you're productive in your first week.

items.title: Claude Code in Action
items.description: Run long, hands-off Claude Code sessions you can trust: steer, configure, automate, and verify

items.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
items.description: Learn to collaborate with AI systems effectively, efficiently, ethically, and safely

items.title: Building with the Claude API
items.description: This comprehensive course covers the full spectrum of working with Anthropic models using the Claude API

items.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
items.description: Learn to build Model Context Protocol servers and clients from scratch using Python. Master MCP's three core primitives—tools, resources, and prompts—to connect Claude with external services

items.title: AI Fluency for educators
items.description: This course empowers faculty, instructional designers, and educational leaders to apply AI Fluency into their own teaching practice and institutional strategy.

items.title: AI Fluency for students
items.description: This course empowers students to develop AI Fluency skills that enhance learning, career planning, and academic success through responsible AI collaboration.

items.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
items.description: Discover advanced Model Context Protocol implementation patterns including sampling, notifications, file system access, and transport mechanisms for production MCP server development.

items.title: Claude with Amazon Bedrock
items.description: As part of an accreditation program created for AWS, Anthropic launched a first-of-its-kind training for AWS employees. Here's the full course so you can follow along.

items.title: Claude on Google Cloud
items.description: This comprehensive course covers the full spectrum of working with Anthropic models on Google Cloud.

items.title: Teaching AI Fluency
items.description: This course empowers academic faculty, instructional designers, and others to teach and assess AI Fluency in instructor-led settings.

items.title: AI Fluency for nonprofits
items.description: This course empowers nonprofit professionals to develop AI fluency in order to increase organizational impact and efficiency while staying true to their mission and values.

items.title: Introduction to agent skills
items.description: Learn how to build, configure, and share Skills in Claude Code — reusable markdown instructions that Claude automatically applies to the right tasks at the right time.

items.title: Introduction to subagents
items.description: Learn how to use and create sub-agents in Claude Code to manage context, delegate tasks, and build specialized workflows that keep your main conversation clean and focused.

items.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
items.description: An introductory course about how AI works

items.title: AI Fluency for Small Businesses
items.description: This course empowers small businesses to develop AI fluency in order to increase organizational impact and efficiency while staying true to their mission and values.

items.title: AI Fluency for Builders
items.description: This course empowers builders to develop AI fluency — increasing impact and efficiency while staying true to what it means to own the full arc from problem to shipped solution.

items.title: AI Fluency for Creative Work
items.description: This course empowers creative professionals to develop AI fluency, making intentional, analysis-driven decisions about AI use in their creative practice while protecting what makes their work theirs.

items.title: Deploying Claude Enterprise with Confidence: The five decisions that shape your rollout
items.description: Make the five decisions that shape how Claude works for your organization — Structure & Identity, Access, Governance, Spend, Visibility — and record them in the rollout plan you keep.

items.title: AI Foundations
items.description: This course will teach you about how to use AI to be more effective as a programmer. It’s not a course to teach about machine learning or how to train your own models, but instead a course focused on developers writing software using AI models and tools.

items.title: AI Foundations
items.description: Learn the basics of AI, large language models, and ChatGPT. You’ll practice giving clear instructions, adding useful context, reviewing outputs, and using AI responsibly in everyday work.

items.title: Applied AI Foundations
items.description: Turn a recurring task into a repeatable workflow. You’ll break the work into steps, identify where ChatGPT can help, and build review points into the process.

items.title: Agents and Workflows
items.description: Practice directing agents through structured work. You’ll provide context, define outputs, set boundaries, review drafts, improve the workflow, and reuse what works.

items.title: Scope AI Solutions
items.description: Identify valuable AI opportunities and turn the strongest into a solution plan.

items.title: Evaluate AI Applications
items.description: Build representative evaluations, diagnose failures, and prevent quality regressions.

items.title: Design and Build Agentic Systems
items.description: Design reliable agents with clear roles, controlled tools, and safe handoffs.

items.title: Build with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.description: Build retrieval pipelines and improve answer quality through evaluation.

items.title: Optimize AI Application Performance
items.description: Balance quality, latency, reliability, throughput, and cost using production evidence.

items.title: Get Started with Codex
items.description: Scope repository tasks, verify code changes, and provide clear review evidence.

items.title: Extend Codex Workflows
items.description: Turn effective Codex habits into reusable, well-governed team workflows.

items.title: Scale Codex Across Governed Teams and Systems
items.description: Coordinate parallel Codex workstreams and integrate their outputs safely.

items.title: AI Leadership
items.description: Learn how to choose AI opportunities worth backing and guide initiatives from business priority to responsible adoption.

items.title: AI for Educators
items.description: Learn how to use ChatGPT to develop teaching materials that align with learning objectives and student needs.

items.title: AI for College Students
items.description: Learn how to use ChatGPT for practical study and career tasks to improve learning outcomes.

items.title: Agent-Friendly APIs
items.description: Build a feedback API, then build a Claude Code skill that generates the documentation agents need to use it.

items.title: Build and Launch with AI
items.description: Build and launch a website for Small Hours Studio with AI. Start in v0, add workshop pages and an email inquiry form, and learn to publish your own updates with fx, GitHub, and Vercel. No coding experience required.

items.title: Build Durable Workflows
items.description: Learn the foundations of the Workflow SDK by building a pizza order tracker. Durable, resumable code with two directives and no state machines.

items.title: Build Visual Workflow Plugins on Vercel
items.description: Deploy a visual workflow builder on Vercel and extend it with plugins for the APIs you actually use. Learn Vercel Workflow fundamentals along the way.

items.title: Build with Next.js
items.description: Learn Next.js by building real apps. Work through routing, data fetching, caching, forms, and error handling, then deploy everything to Vercel.

items.title: Build with v0
items.description: Build, customize, and ship a real website with v0. No code required.

items.title: Build Your Own AI Coding Agent Harness
items.description: Build an AI coding agent harness from scratch using AI SDK, Vercel Sandbox, and just-bash. Covers the tool loop, tool design, system prompts, sandbox abstraction, context pruning, subagent delegation, lifecycle management, and extensibility.

items.title: Builders Guide to the AI SDK
items.description: Build production-ready AI features with the AI SDK & Next.js. Learn LLMs, prompting, extraction, streaming, & more.

items.title: Building Agents with eve
items.description: Build a production bike shop dispatcher agent with eve, from its first typed tool to a deployed app behind Slack, a web dashboard, real auth, and human approval.

items.title: Building Filesystem Agents
items.description: Build a filesystem agent that uses bash tools and Vercel Sandbox to explore call transcripts and answer questions.

items.title: Creating a Software Factory
items.description: Build a risk-routed software factory that requires evidence before code changes and preserves human control over consequential decisions.

items.title: Creating an AI Summary App with Next.js
items.description: Build an AI-powered summary application using Next.js App Router and the Vercel AI SDK. You'll implement text summarization, structured output, caching, and production-ready patterns.

items.title: Deploy on Vercel
items.description: A 1-hour video series covering the most important Vercel concepts. Nine short sessions to get you productive on the platform.

items.title: Enterprise Apps and Agents
items.description: Take an internal AI prototype from demo to rollout: assign owners, restrict access, test model behavior, and add human approval.

items.title: Launch a Subscription Store with Vercel and Stripe
items.description: Build a production-ready subscription storefront with Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase Auth, and Stripe. Learn authentication, payments, and access control.

items.title: Make Decisions with Jev
items.description: Use Jev to route customer messages to the right team. Start with a working contact form, teach it who handles cancellations, and test your rules with different requests.

items.title: Microfrontends on Vercel
items.description: Build scalable, independent frontend applications with Vercel's microfrontends platform.

items.title: Nuxt on Vercel
items.description: Translate your React and Next.js skills to Nuxt. Build a hot springs finder app using idiomatic Nuxt patterns, from reactivity to auth to deployment.

items.title: Optimize Your Vercel Account
items.description: Audit and tune your Vercel account for security, cost, and operations.

items.title: Production Monorepos with Turborepo
items.description: Build a production monorepo from idea to enterprise scale with Turborepo and Next.js.

items.title: Python on Vercel
items.description: Keep your Python stack and ship it with your frontend. Build a FastAPI + Next.js furniture app deployed as one Vercel project.

items.title: React UI with shadcn/ui + Radix + Tailwind
items.description: Learn the fundamentals of modern UI development with shadcn/ui. Master component libraries, Radix primitives, and build production-ready interfaces.

items.title: Slack Agents on Vercel with the AI SDK
items.description: Step-by-step course to build, deploy, and run a real Slack bot on Vercel using the AI SDK, with logging, safeguards, and an ops runbook for your team’s workspace.

items.title: Svelte on Vercel
items.description: Build production-ready SvelteKit applications on Vercel. Learn deployment, AI integration, workflows, and performance optimization.

items.title: Using AI Gateway in Production
items.description: Learn how AI Gateway handles model access, routing, spend, privacy, developer tools, and production authentication.

items.title: Vercel Sandbox
items.description: Learn how to safely execute untrusted code using Vercel Sandbox. Build a CLI code review agent that clones repositories, runs tests, and uses AI to analyze code for security and quality issues, all in an isolated environment.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional AI Infrastructure

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional AI Operations
items.description: Demonstrate the skills needed to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize NVIDIA AI infrastructure.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional AI Networking
items.description: Showcase the ability to deploy and configure environments that leverage NVIDIA’s advanced networking technologies.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional AI Rack and Interconnect
items.description: Validate the skills to safely install, cable, and connect NVIDIA AI infrastructure.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate AI Infrastructure and Operations
items.description: Validate a candidate’s knowledge of foundational concepts of AI computing related to infrastructure and operations.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional Accelerated Data Science
items.description: Demonstrate proficiency in leveraging GPU-accelerated tools and libraries for data science workflows.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate Accelerated Data Science
items.description: Verify a candidate’s understanding of GPU-accelerated data science concepts for preparing data, developing models, and managing end-to-end workflows.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional Generative AI LLMs
items.description: Certify the ability to design, train, and optimize LLMs, leveraging advanced distributed training and fine-tuning strategies to deliver high-performance AI solutions.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional Agentic AI
items.description: Demonstrate the ability to build and govern advanced agentic AI solutions with multi-agent interaction, scalability, and ethical safeguards.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate Generative AI LLM
items.description: Verify foundational knowledge for developing, integrating, and maintaining AI-driven applications using generative AI and LLMs with NVIDIA solutions.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate Generative AI Multimodal
items.description: Validates the foundational skills needed to design, implement, and manage AI systems that synthesize and interpret data across text, image, and audio modalities.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate AI Models and Application Development
items.description: Validates foundational skills in building, customizing, deploying, and evaluating AI models and applications on NVIDIA’s platform, including retrieval pipelines, inference optimization, and agentic systems.

items.title: NVIDIA-Certified Professional OpenUSD Development
items.description: Verify a candidate’s ability to build, maintain, and optimize 3D content creation pipelines using OpenUSD.
